memories.content: [Context Note] Similar tasks have benefited from explicitly mapping image coordinates to patient anatomy before assigning laterality, since naive image position can mislead. One approach that worked was cross-checking any localization claim against the image's anatomical orientation to resolve left/right ambiguity.

metadata.original_query:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?

metadata.retrieval_focus: Localizing and distinguishing left versus right anatomical sides in medical imaging, and identifying foreign objects or artifacts by their spatial position relative to body landmarks.
